text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—Eh, is this Dantsu's Umastagram?
Awesome~!
She posts super frequently, huh.

The one chatting with Dantsu Flame is
the precocious prodigy Umamusume,
Mayano Top Gun.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~. ...Even so, though,
it hasn't grown at all, has it?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Maya really likes it, though~. Like, simple posts with 'I'll do my best at training!' and a picture of flowers and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I can totally feel Dantsu-san's gentle vibe radiating straight through the screen!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. Thank you!
Just hearing you say that makes me happy."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so cute~♡
This looks great, I'll send it over!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Let's post to Umastagram together!
We can tag each other, y'know?
C'mon, going viral is all about teamwork♡

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait!
Someone else got caught in the frame~.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Brian-san and Furioso-san, along with
Gimlet-san and... No Reason-san—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Aren't there way too many photobombers...?!
L-Let's take it again~!

To stoke the flames born at the Japan Derby
even higher for the Kikuka Sho—
a fiercely intense summer training camp has begun!
